heroSourceLine: Source: Canyons School District 2026–27 K-12 calendar · Revised November 12, 2025
heroSummary: Canyons students in grades 1–12 start Monday, August 17, 2026, following half-day orientation for sixth- and ninth-graders on August 14. Kindergarten starts August 19. Graduation is May 25, and the last day of school is May 27. Every instructional Friday is an early-out day, while Brighton High School follows a separate trimester calendar.
calendarNotes: Canyons schedules teachers back August 10–14 and a half-day sixth- and ninth-grade orientation August 14 before grades 1–12 begin August 17. Kindergarten starts August 19. The K-12 calendar marks every instructional Friday as early out and uses red A-day and black B-day labels for secondary rotation. Level-specific September and February conferences lead into districtwide early-out, compensatory, or professional no-student dates. Fall Recess is October 15–16, Winter Recess is December 21–January 1, and Spring Break is April 5–9. Brighton High School shares the August 17 opening and May 27 ending but uses trimesters, separate grading and conference dates, and several school-specific professional days. Emergency closures are made up through later remote-learning days rather than a fixed calendar date.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: Grades 1–12 begin August 17, one day earlier than the August 18 opening in 2025–26; kindergarten also moves one day earlier to August 19.
The districtwide fall early-out day is September 24, one day earlier than in 2025–26. It is followed by a compensatory day on September 25 and a teacher professional day on September 28.
Fall Recess is October 15–16, one week earlier than in 2025–26. Spring Break begins April 5, one day earlier than last year.
The last day of school is May 27, two days earlier than in 2025–26.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Canyons School District start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 begin Monday, August 17, 2026. Sixth- and ninth-graders have half-day orientation on August 14, and kindergarten begins August 19.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Canyons Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break Recess runs Monday, April 5 through Friday, April 9, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Brighton High School use the K-12 quarter calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Brighton uses a separate trimester calendar with different grading, conference, professional, and compensatory dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Is every Friday an early-out day in Canyons?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Both the K–12 and Brighton PDFs say every instructional Friday is an early-out day; the exact dismissal time is school-specific.

calendarFaqs.q: Is there a Spanish Canyons calendar for 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. CSD publishes Spanish K–12 and Brighton PDFs. The Spanish PDFs label April 5–9 as Fall Break, while the English K–12 and Brighton calendars label the same dates Spring Break; this page uses the English-calendar label.

calendarFaqs.q: How are emergency closures made up?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendars say closure days will be recovered through scheduled remote-learning days rather than a fixed date printed in advance.
